steps.text: Set up: create an API key (Settings owns this; see api-keys-settings.ts)
Integration: submit three URLs with the key, no cookie or Origin
The key cannot reach private routes; a missing key is 401
Resending the same URL is a Duplicate with no batch
Activity lists the batch with the key name
Cancel the API batch from Activity
Demo B sees none of it

checks.name: API: 202 with three created results and a batchId
API: no CORS headers on the response
API: GET /api/library with the key is 401
API: a request without a key is 401
API: Demo A's library has the batch with the API source
Exactly one batch can be cancelled
API: the batch has no active jobs and some were cancelled
Activity no longer offers Cancel batch
Activity still labels the batch "Extract context · API · Shortcuts 543"
API: Demo B has no links or batches from the key
